notes.subject: את
notes.rationale: This את is the pronoun אַתְ 'you' (feminine), not the direct-object marker — rendered 'wena', not ⟨את⟩.

notes.subject: verb subjects
notes.rationale: Ketiv reads the perfects as 1cs 'I broke' (Yahwe as subject); qere and many versions read 2fs 'you broke' — the object-reversal is a famous crux.

notes.subject: גבעה גבהה
notes.rationale: Alliteration: 'hill... high' — the root sounds repeat, lost in Sepedi.

notes.subject: o nyantšha
notes.rationale: זנה is cultic prostitution/fornication as metaphor for idolatry; 'nyantšha' keeps the sexual picture the prophets intend.

translation: Ka gobane go tloga kale o phutheletše bokgole bja gago, o lotše dikgogo tša gago, gomme o ile wa re: Nke ke šome; ka gobane godimo ga thaba e nngwe le e nngwe e phagamego, le ka fasana ga mohlare o mongwe le o mongwe o talago, wena o sepela o nyantšha.

tokens.gloss: e nngwe le e nngwe / o mongwe le o mongwe
